description: This file is a shell script that performs tests related to the 'git-http-backend' functionality, focusing on aspects such as handling of CONTENT_LENGTH, content encoding, and HTTP request simulations for Git operations.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Verifies the HTTP result status, checking for fatal errors and matching expected status codes within the output.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up and executes an HTTP environment for testing 'git-http-backend' with specified content types and request bodies.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Calculates a size that exceeds the maximum value of ssize_t for testing overflow handling.
